warnings: Steel hip roof over an L-shaped plan, members from the sheet's หมายเหตุ legend (line pattern -> member): แป เหล็กกล่อง 25x25x1.6 @0.32-0.34 (or galvanized 7 mm), จันทัน C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00, ตะเข้ราง C-100x50x20x3.2, ตะเข้สัน 2C-100x50x20x3.2, อกไก่ 2C-150x50x20x3.2, TRUSS T1, TRUSS T2 (both drawn on S-05). Roofing หลังคามุงกระเบื้องซีแพคโมเนีย (not structural, not recorded).

Truss T1 is used twice: along y = 1.75 (A'', from grid 1 to 6'') and along x = 10.25 (6'', from A'' to G); the S-05 elevation (supports at 0 / 5.00 / 8.51, deep end with eave overhang, shallow 0.70 end) fits both runs — A''1 / A''4 / A''6 / A''6'' and G6'' / D6'' / B6'' / A''6''. Split at its supports (RB beam at A''1 and G6'', steel posts at A''4, A''6, B6'', D6''). The T1 panel chain ends 1.80 past its last support (0.90 x 2) against 1.75 on the plan chains (A''6 -> A''6'', B6'' -> A''6'') — 0.05 drafting difference, plan grid taken.

Truss T2 runs along the north-east hip from the 150x150 post at B'5'' to the building corner A7 with a mid support at B6; the S-05 panel chain (1.06 x 2 + 0.99 x 5 = 7.07) equals the grid diagonal B'5'' -> A7 (√(5² + 5²) = 7.07) and its first support at 2.12 equals B'5'' -> B6 (√(1.5² + 1.5²) = 2.12).

Ridge (อกไก่) traced from the long-dash lines: x = 4.09 from A''3' to C3', a 45° run C3' -> D'5, then y = 7.91 from D'5 to D'6''. Split at the steel posts (B3', C3', D'5, D'6). The ridge has no printed mark — element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2).

Hips, valleys, rafters and purlins carry no mark and end at the eave line, which is not dimensioned on any swept sheet — recorded as four aggregate entries (section, spacing) with count null, not as positioned segments; their individual positions are deliberately not invented. The truss/ridge segments reuse the posts' grid lines from the S-03 chains (S-04 reprints the same chains).
